name: 01921 · Boxford, MA
findings: ZIP 01921 (Boxford) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01921 (Boxford) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
